name: Planet Ozi
summary: ISP (Planet Ozi Pty Ltd, ACN 108 139 037) that absorbed CairnsNet customer base (2017) and ran Silogen/Starwon brand; ADSL/NBN/dialup provider; creditors' voluntary liquidation 7 Feb 2019; business/customers sold to Adelaide's EscapeNet (esc.net.au) ~Mar 2019; ABN cancelled 2020.

events.details: Planet Ozi Pty Ltd incorporated; business name TSN Internet.com.au from Mar 2004.

Creditors' voluntary liquidation appointed 7 Feb 2019 (ASIC, ACN 108 139 037); business/customers sold to EscapeNet (Adelaide) ~Mar 2019; residual site wound down by ~2021. Company liquidated 7 Feb 2019 with the base sold to EscapeNet — the proposed Feb 2019 date is confirmed exactly.

refs.label: ASIC published-notices entry (s491(2)(b)) confirms creditors' voluntary liquidation appointment 7 Feb 2019.
Corroborates closure; customers were taken over by EscapeNet around the liquidation.
